description: Part single storey, part two storey rear and side extension, front porch, extension of roof to side to form gable, rear dormer and front roof lights.
decision_conditions: The proposed two storey side extension and gable end roof extension by reason of their detailed design, projection, siting and proximity to the site boundary would appear visually intrusive, incongruous, overly dominant and out of keeping with the character and appearance of the host building and the surrounding area of which it forms part, contrary to Policies DP2, DP3 and DP4 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD6, DMD8, DMD14 and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed first floor rear extension and rear dormer by reason of their bulk, mass, scale and detailed design would appear visually intrusive, incongruous, overly dominant, fail to be subordinate to the host dwelling and would be out of keeping with the character and appearance of the surrounding area, contrary to Policies DP2, DP3 and DP4 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD6, DMD8, DMD11, DMD13 and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed ground floor rear extension, by virtue of its depth, height,  siting, width and proximity to the site boundary would give rise to an unneighbourly loss of privacy, sunlight and daylight, outlook, as perceived from neighbouring properties including No. 26 Ascot Gardens contrary to Policies CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD8 and DMD11 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
